checklist.title: Right away
items: Find out whether the site is inside city limits, in the city’s extraterritorial jurisdiction (ETJ) or on unincorporated county land
Join TCEQ’s mailing list for your county
Search TCEQ’s Commissioners’ Integrated Database for the company and address
Pull up the next planning commission, council, commissioners court and school board agendas
Contact neighbors within 200 feet about a protest petition

checklist.title: When a notice appears
items: Write down every deadline in the notice. The NORI window for air permits is the one people miss.
File a written TCEQ comment, and a contested case hearing request if you are an affected person
Request a TCEQ “public meeting” by name, and ask your legislator to request one too
Sign up to speak at the zoning hearing and submit written comments
File public information requests for NDAs, emails and applications

checklist.title: Before the final vote
items: File the protest petition with the city
Ask for clawbacks, water limits, noise rules and setbacks in any abatement or development agreement
Ask whether the company has filed its TWDB water use survey

checklist.title: After a decision
items: 20 days to appeal a city staff decision to the Board of Adjustment
23 days after notice of a signed TCEQ permit to file a motion to overturn
25 days after a TCEQ commissioners’ decision to file a motion for rehearing
Talk to a lawyer early if you may go to court. Some deadlines are only 10 days.
